story:
Issued For Destruction was born in 2016, when Thomas and Rune started jamming together with no real plan — just a shared love for heavy riffs.

Johne soon joined, forming a trio that built the foundation of the band’s raw and aggressive sound. As the band evolved, Kristoffer and Johannes joined, pushing the music further into heavier and darker territory.

In 2023, Johne left the band. Shortly after, Jarle joined on vocals, bringing new energy and a new chapter for Issued For Destruction.
